reviews.author: Nakiyah Johnson
reviews.text: Great hospitality and quick service! Roger is really great at answering questions and shows great patience for us non-car people! Definitely recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Rayna Taylor
reviews.text: Such helpful, friendly brothers! They were very thorough and provided videos and helped explain the problems the car was having. Will definitely have our mechanic for good!

reviews.author: Abdullah Hameed
reviews.text: Excellent and honest service! The mechanic was knowledgeable, quick, and explained everything clearly. I had my brake pads replaced and the work was done with care and precision. Fair pricing, no hidden charges. Highly recommended, will definitely come back for future repairs

reviews.author: Nichole Bromell
reviews.text: The quality of work is top-notch! My car now runs better than ever. What really stood out was their honesty and professionalism. They never tried to upsell unnecessary services. It’s rare to find an auto shop that combines technical expertise with exceptional customer service, but Lifetime Automotive nails it. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for trustworthy, efficient, and skilled automotive care. I’ll definitely be back for any future maintenance or repairs!

reviews.author: WILMA korch
reviews.text: I had my brakes done here and couldn’t be happier with the service. Honest, efficient, and very knowledgeable. My car feels brand new again! The pricing was fair, and they explained everything clearly before getting started. It’s hard to find a mechanic you can really trust, but I definitely found mine. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Will Davis
reviews.text: I have an associates degree in automotive and I just want you guys to know how thorough and knowledgeable these guys are! Brought vehicles in not knowing the issue and they were already troubleshooting the problem before seeing the vehicles. Pricing was incredible especially considering how hard they work to get your vehicle back to you. I'm a returning customer and had my vehicle back quickly every single time. Thanks Roger for taking care of my family! Stop by and say hi to Diesel!

reviews.author: Igor Prohorov
reviews.text: Very shady business practice. Checkup itself was 204 dollars which was bad enough, only to find out that when we came back to pickup the car, the total was 433 dollars because the dude decided to add freon when nothing was even agreed upon. Very disingenuous. UPDATE: Contrary to what the reply says, my wife just wanted to get out of there and paid. She did not agree to any services other than the initial checkup, which was a whopping 204 dollars. It is an absolute FACT that Roger performed services WITHOUT permission and only offered a refund on service we've never initially agreed to. Why would I trust a very disingenuous business to continue any additional services on our vehicle. The least you can do is simply charge the 204 dollars for the checkup we agreed to.

reviews.author: Nichole Bromell
reviews.text: The owner is very knowledgeable and genuinely interested in helping his customers. He took the time to explain the issues clearly, provided a fair and transparent estimate, and completed the repairs faster than I expected. He has great communication skills explaining different options that best suit the customer and I couldn’t be more impressed.

reviews.author: Mason Yoder
reviews.text: My car recently failed an inspection, so I called Roger at Lifetime Automotive. He got me in immediately the next day, despite it being the day after New Years, and not only replaced all four of my tires and my brakes, but also a couple other minor things that he noticed needed replacing once he started working on it. This was the 1st time Roger has worked on my car, but he has worked on many of my family members cars over the years. He is always extremely kind and supportive. He helps fix the issues quickly and precisely, so you're not without your vehicle for long. He did a great job on my car. I will not hesitate to call Roger in the future.

reviews.author: John Messina
reviews.text: Roger was awesome and treated us fairly! his entire family including his beautiful dog treated us so well. Couldn’t thank you enough for getting us out of a bind.

reviews.author: Brad Yoder
reviews.text: Lifetime automotive repair & service is my go to shop. Roger is always very helpful, answers all questions & takes the time to explain & make sure the customer understands the work that he will be doing on your vehicle. The work is also done in a very timely manner as well. Just brought my son's car in for a series of repairs. Thanks again for the great work as always Roger!

reviews.author: Gavin Herzog
reviews.text: Lifetime Automotive has brought the trust back to mechanics for me. Roger and his family are so insanely kind and supportive. And especially Roger’s bedside manner and professionalism makes me confident to take my car to him for anything it may need. Come in and check them out. I promise you will not be disappointed. Thanks again to Roger and his lovely family for always taking care of me and my friends vehicles!

reviews.author: Jared Thomas
reviews.text: Lifetime was able to get my dead car towed AND repaired in less than 24 hours. They replaced my alternator while also taking note of any problems I might come back for in the future, and I will be back. They were super helpful and understanding in letting me deal with any warranties I had on replaced defective parts to help me keep the price down. If you're looking for friendly, honest professionals then look no further!

reviews.author: Nichole Schmidt
reviews.text: Reliable, Honest, and Skilled, A Shop You Can Trust I always have an excellent experience at. After dealing with a few less-than-reliable shops in the past, it was refreshing to find a place that truly values integrity and customer satisfaction. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Andrea Vidrio
reviews.text: -Rodger serviced my car. Excellent communication throughout entire process. Got my car fixed up in a timely manner. -A lot of mechanics do not, but thankfully here I was able to bring in my own car parts to be installed. Also has very cute, friendly dog.

reviews.author: Bree Prohorov
reviews.text: Roger was extremely friendly, knowledgeable and helpful in working on my car. Unfortunately, a year later, Roger did us wrong. We live paycheck to paycheck, and we got a nasty bill of 433.16 for a 204 dollar checkup which, although was very expensive, we agreed to, but then he added on costs to services that we did NOT agree to such as adding freon and presented me with that bill. I felt pressured to just pay the bill and wash my hands with it, but after showing my husband the bill, he called Roger back and demanded that he refunds the money and only charges us 204 for the checkup we agreed to. Roger shockingly refused and said if we want a refund to come back to the shop and allow him to work on our car again and take out the Freon. Why on earth would anyone allow a shady businessman like Roger to continue working on their car when they’ve already done services that weren’t even agreed upon? I highly suggest Roger refunds us the money immediately.

reviews.author: K. Disney
reviews.text: Roger is a very professional mechanic, goes above and beyond for his customers, is diligent with communication, and is quick to schedule in work. His shop is quickly becoming my go to for all mechanical needs.

reviews.author: Kelvin Bell
reviews.text: Roger is a very far person who does really great work. Every time I took my vehicle to him he got on it when he said he could and ALWAYS give honest fare prices. I will continue to take my vehicle here. Hope him much success and longevity. He his truly needed in the area. Thanks Roger for ALWAYS giving me great service.

reviews.author: Shanqual Foster
reviews.text: I highly recommend Lifetime auto. My first time here and The owner Roger was very professional. His prices are very affordable and reasonable and if you’re having any financial issues he recommends many resources to help you out. He had my car in and out in a flash I couldn’t believe it. I will definitely continue to have my car serviced here from here on out. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Jonathon Simmons
reviews.text: Great Service, friendly family company. They are reliable and straight forward. I enjoy the transparency. Will be taking all of our vehicle needs to lifetime from now on. They did a fantastic job on my lift kit. Thank you so much, helping make a mans dream truck come true.

reviews.author: Bam B
reviews.text: I must say that Roger explains very well with visual what the problem is with your vehicle. Everything is done in a timely manner. Even though I do not mind leaving it for a few days, I always get my vehicle back sooner than expected. Roger is fair, and as a woman, I do not feel like I am being taken advantage of. The pups are such sweeties! A bonus!! <3 10 out of 10, I'd defiantly recommend.

reviews.author: Zsazsa Davis
reviews.text: You got to love lifetime automotive. This is my 3rd time bringing my vehicle here. They're very honest,loyal, reasonable, and done a great job repairing my vehicle. They will work pass working hours to satisfy their customers.

reviews.author: kord HD tech
reviews.text: Awesome shop, diag and fixed car quickly. Roger knows what he is talking about and knows what he is doing. And love his dog Diesel. Only shop I will go to for now on.

reviews.author: Eric Kreutzberg
reviews.text: Called short notice earlier in the morning to see if they would be willing to work on my Miata. Was at the shop an hour later and they were ready to get to work on my car. Replaced my alternator in about an hour and very fair price. Would definitely recommend to friends and trust them with both of my vehicles.

reviews.author: Jake Hamblin
reviews.text: I brought in my 2009 Chevy Impala that had a plethora of issues, but this place quickly helped sort everything out at a VERY good price! The owner was very reliable and courteous and updated me on the situation often. I cannot recommend this place enough!

reviews.author: Russell Fowler
reviews.text: Greatest experience I've had with an auto shop in 40 year's, do not trust people,made me feel real comfortable will be my service center for my car!

reviews.author: Benjamin White
reviews.text: While on a road trip to Newport News my A/C Compressor blew out. Roger expertly diagnosed the problems, secured and installed replacement parts within a 24 hour timespan! Wow! He actually did everything he said he would do! He also did a complete under the hood inspection to make sure there were no other pending surprises! The repair bill was very reasonable. Most importantly, Roger is an honest, fair and outstanding person and professional mechanic/business man. It was an absolute pleasure doing business with him and I will check in with him whenver I am in the area. Ben W.

reviews.author: Diego Almaraz
reviews.text: I'm so glad for the great service we got from lifetime automotive. We came from a long trip to visit my brother and had a problem with my wheel on my toyota rav4 NY brother recommended them and they took care of our problem so fast and easy we didn't have to worry about anything.

reviews.author: Nick Linson
reviews.text: I drive an older car that some dealerships out here wont help with and had been to multiple different mechanic trying to find a reliable one. This one won’t let you down did many different things I’ve been desperately needing to drive my car and what would’ve taken and dealership months took this place 6 day. They communicate and talk you through every and even went above and beyond and fix some mistakes I made when I worked on it. I now have my car running brand new and can’t thank them enough !

reviews.author: Suzanna Bryant
reviews.text: Skilled and honest mechanic. He gives great feedback, documentation, and timely repairs. You will know exactly what to expect and options for your situation. Will definitely be following up for all my maintenance and repairs in the future.

reviews.author: Karen Buchholz
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable, honest and service done in a timely manner. Won’t take my car to anyone else. Roger has been my mechanic for many years!

reviews.author: Natasha Shimchayah Castanon
reviews.text: Roger was very thorough and got me in same day for a pre-purchase inspection! Highly appreciate his professionalism and expertise! Would recommend.

reviews.author: Anita Peters
reviews.text: Wish we had discovered this shop before. Like a local cafe, sometimes the small, local shops like this are a hidden gem. I have gotten good advice and service at a fair price, especially when I was being steered wrong by the Car Dealership Service Department. I highly recommend you try this shop out!

reviews.author: James Hill
reviews.text: Rodger does great work, every time I have taken my vehicles to him , every thing was fixed and I have never had to return for anything not done correctly. , also I have referred this business to family and friends .

reviews.author: Tamara Selmon
reviews.text: Customer service is excellent. Prices are reasonable and they tell you up front cost of repair. Friendly staff. I highly recommend lifetime automotive. For excellent quality service.

reviews.author: Latika Smith
reviews.text: If you are ever looking for a shop that keeps you up to date, step by step, reliable and honest service, please head over to Lifetime Automotive Repair & Services. Great team here!

reviews.author: Tyrick Jones
reviews.text: Great customer service, kept me updated every step of the way! I would recommend them to anyone with car trouble!

reviews.author: Christie Carter
reviews.text: Great work on my car brakes, lights and changed my battery for a reasonable price.Great costumer service

reviews.author: Anita L “GiGi” Michaels
reviews.text: Omgoodness. This place is awesome and the person to see is Roger. He definitely knows his stuff and adds a personal touch and care to your vehicle like it was his own

reviews.author: Donald DiScioscia
reviews.text: I do all my automotive service here. They are friendly and you can trust them to be honest with you regarding any work that needs to be done..

reviews.author: Robert Munoz
reviews.text: Was able to walk right in and get my vehicle taken care of the same day. Very professional and friendly staff

reviews.author: lisa thomas
reviews.text: I absolutely love this place and will be coming here more often staff was great at keeping me informed about the service I will receive plus warranty they were polite I had a great experience with their services and recommend people to this shop reasonable price.

reviews.author: Eric Tide
reviews.text: Stay away from this place they won't honor warranties. Roger is very unprofessional and wont stand behind his work. Do it right the first time!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Juan Iraola
reviews.text: This place was very detailed and thorough about fixing my vehicle, gave good recommendations and various ways to fix what needed to be fixed. Check this place out for any car needs.

reviews.author: Lavonne
reviews.text: Guys were really nice! Got the job done quick with no problems! Real quality work. Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Vanessa Oliveira-Brown
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience getting my car serviced here! Roger took great care of my vehicle and the pricing was very reasonable. He was able to fit me in at my earliest convenience and even accommodated me dropping off my vehicle early in the morning. The communication was excellent. I totally recommend, especially if you have a Toyota!

reviews.author: Austin Lopez
reviews.text: Paid almost 200$ for a cylinder misfire diagnostic and he didn’t even find the issue, just recommended i buy a bunch of expensive parts that were unrelated to the issue. 2 stars since he was nice and fit me in a tight schedule last minute and gave me some decent advice.
